items.title: The Big Caveats (Keep These in Mind)
items.text: High Sycophancy: Standard LLMs tend to agree with you and validate your side too much, which can reinforce unhealthy biases instead of holding you accountable. Triangulation Risk: Bringing a third-party AI into an active dispute between two humans can sometimes bypass the actual vulnerability required to fix things together. No Shared Reality: An AI only knows the biased, one-sided story you type into the chatbox. It doesn't see your partner's non-verbal cues, tone, or history.
items.markdown:
- **High Sycophancy:** Standard LLMs tend to agree with you and validate your side *too much* , which can reinforce unhealthy biases instead of holding you accountable.
- **Triangulation Risk:** Bringing a third-party AI into an active dispute between two humans can sometimes bypass the actual vulnerability required to fix things together.
- **No Shared Reality:** An AI only knows the biased, one-sided story *you* type into the chatbox. It doesn't see your partner's non-verbal cues, tone, or history.[[1]](https://www.npr.org/2025/08/05/nx-s1-5490447/ai-chatgpt-couples-therapy-advice)
